title: Light Thai Beef Nam Prik
description: A peppery and flavorful Nam Prik made with feather blade beef, wood-fired bake, and a variety of fresh ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a wood-fired oven or a conventional oven to 500°F (260°C).
Prepare the ingredients by chopping the garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and chilies.
Season the feather blade beef with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in an oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on both sides, then transfer to a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine the chilies, garlic, ginger, and lemongrass in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar to the blender and blend until well combined.
Return the beef to the oven and roast for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Remove the beef from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly.
Serve the sliced beef with the Nam Prik sauce spooned over the top.
